rules.statement: Property burdened with a fidei commissum can be partitioned under the Ordinance, but such partition does not extinguish the reversionary interest of the fiduciary.
rules.supporting_quote: "Not one of these enactments (one of them being the Ordinance in question) professes to deal with or alter the law of fidei commissum : and in their Lordships' opinion they cannot be construed as having that effect" - Lord Watson
